title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
Join our creative team as a Senior Graphic Designer. Key Responsibilities:
- Create engaging graphics for digital and print media, including websites, social media, and marketing materials.
- Collaborate with the marketing team to develop brand campaigns.
- Guide and mentor junior designers.
- Ensure brand consistency across all visual content.
Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design or related field.
- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
- Strong portfolio showcasing creative design solutions.
- Excellent eye for detail and typography.
